text:
A Lake Wind Advisory is in effect, so if the waterfront is on your Wednesday agenda, go early and stay close to shore. It’s clear and cool now, but clouds thicken quickly, with rain arriving by late morning or early afternoon and becoming steadier this evening. Expect a high near 74, south winds building to 15 to 25 knots on the lake and gusting close to 30, with waves reaching 3 feet. Rain and a few rumbles continue tonight, with another half-inch to three-quarters of an inch possible.

Thursday should turn mostly sunny after a few early showers, with a high near 79 and gusty west winds. The forecast is less settled than that quick clearing suggests, though, and some guidance keeps a shower risk around longer than the official call. I’d keep Thursday morning flexible, then plan outdoor time for the afternoon, and stay off the lake today once the south wind starts building.
